description: Indicators the extractor currently promotes on real-report labels although the publisher does not assert them (recorded, NOT accepted). A fix removes its entries; realReports.test.js fails on any FP not listed here and on a listed FP that no longer occurs. Updated for P1 (tl-candidates-v26 / tl-zones-v10): Huntress / DTrack body-table FPs and NCSC legitimate-service list FPs retired; remaining NCSC chrome domains and one Raven bare URL prefix.

causes.advisory_chrome_discovery: MODE B advisory pages with no IOC appendix still promote publisher chrome / reporting URLs (agency contact domains, partner agency links) from unlabelled body lists or short link rows.
